sources.snippet: G1 Relevant source files This document provides platform-specific technical documentation for the Unitree G1 humanoid robot (29 DOF). It covers the joint configuration, MJCF model integration, and deployment-specific configurations for both velocity tracking and motion imitation (mimic) policies. For the reduced degree-of-freedom variant, see G1 23-DOF.

sources.title: Unitree RL Mjlab - GitHub
sources.snippet: Unitree RL Mjlab is a reinforcement learning project built upon the mjlab, using MuJoCo as its physics simulation backend, currently supporting Unitree Go2, A2, As2, G1, R1, H1_2 and H2. Mjlab combines Isaac Lab 's proven API with best-in-class MuJoCo physics to provide lightweight, modular abstractions for RL robotics research and sim-to-real deployment.
